verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到毘土珥的儿子约珥：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到毘土珥的儿子约珥：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到毗土珥的儿子约珥。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord that came to Joel son of Pethuel.
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave this message to Joel son of Pethuel.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel:
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord that came to Joel son of Pethuel.

verses.textZh: 老年人哪！你们要听这话。 这地所有的居民啊！你们要留心听。 在你们的日子， 或在你们祖先的日子， 曾有这样的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 老年人哪！你们要听这话。 这地所有的居民啊！你们要留心听。 在你们的日子， 或在你们祖先的日子， 曾有这样的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人哪，当听我的话； 国中的居民哪，都要侧耳而听。 在你们的日子， 或你们列祖的日子， 曾有这样的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your ancestors?
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this, you elders; give ear, all inhabitants of the land! Has such a thing happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear this, you elders, And give ear, all you inhabitants of the land! Has anythinglike this happened in your days, Or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.textEnNlt: Hear this, you leaders of the people. Listen, all who live in the land. In all your history, has anything like this happened before?
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this, you elders, And listen, all inhabitants of the land. Has anything like this happened in your days, Or in your fathers’ days?
verses.textEn: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your ancestors?

verses.textZh: 你们要把这事传与子， 子传与孙， 孙传与后代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把这事传与子， 子传与孙， 孙传与后代。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将这事传与子， 子传与孙， 孙传与后代。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children to another generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell your children about it, Let your children tell their children, And their children another generation.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell your children about it in the years to come, and let your children tell their children. Pass the story down from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: Tell your sons about it, And have your sons tell their sons, And their sons the next generation.
verses.textEn: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

verses.textZh: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫吃了； 蝗虫剩下的，蝻子吃了； 蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫吃了； 蝗虫剩下的，蝻子吃了； 蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫来吃； 蝗虫剩下的，蝻子来吃； 蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱来吃。
verses.textEnNiv: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: What the cutting locust left, the swarming locust has eaten. What the swarming locust left, the hopping locust has eaten, and what the hopping locust left, the destroying locust has eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: What the chewing locust left, the swarming locust has eaten; What the swarming locust left, the crawling locust has eaten; And what the crawling locust left, the consuming locust has eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: After the cutting locusts finished eating the crops, the swarming locusts took what was left! After them came the hopping locusts, and then the stripping locusts, too!
verses.textEnNasb: What the gnawing locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten; And what the swarming locust has left, the creeping locust has eaten; And what the creeping locust has left, the stripping locust has eaten.
verses.textEn: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.

verses.textZh: 酒醉的人哪！你们要醒过来；要哀哭！ 所有嗜酒的人哪！你们都要为甜酒哀号， 因为甜酒从你们的口里断绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 酒醉的人哪！你们要醒过来；要哀哭！ 所有嗜酒的人哪！你们都要为甜酒哀号， 因为甜酒从你们的口里断绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣； 好酒的人哪，都要为甜酒哀号， 因为从你们的口中断绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, you drunkards, and weep, and wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, you drunkards, and weep; And wail, all you drinkers of wine, Because of the new wine, For it has been cut off from your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you wine-drinkers! All the grapes are ruined, and all your sweet wine is gone.
verses.textEnNasb: Awake, you heavy drinkers, and weep; And wail, all you wine drinkers, Because of the sweet wine, For it has been eliminated from your mouth.
verses.textEn: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.

verses.textZh: 因为有一民族上来侵犯我的国土， 他们强大又无数； 他们的牙齿像狮子的牙齿， 他们有母狮的大牙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一民族上来侵犯我的国土， 他们强大又无数； 他们的牙齿像狮子的牙齿， 他们有母狮的大牙。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一队蝗虫 又强盛又无数， 侵犯我的地； 它的牙齿如狮子的牙齿， 大牙如母狮的大牙。
verses.textEnNiv: A nation has invaded my land, a mighty army without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.
verses.textEnEsv: For a nation has come up against my land, powerful and beyond number; its teeth are lions’ teeth, and it has the fangs of a lioness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a nation has come up against My land, Strong, and without number; His teeth are the teeth of a lion, And he has the fangs of a fierce lion.
verses.textEnNlt: A vast army of locusts has invaded my land, a terrible army too numerous to count. Its teeth are like lions’ teeth, its fangs like those of a lioness.
verses.textEnNasb: For a nation has invaded my land, Mighty and without number; Its teeth are the teeth of a lion, And it has the jaws of a lioness.
verses.textEn: A nation has invaded my land, a mighty army without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.

verses.textZh: 他们使我的葡萄树荒凉， 折断了我的无花果树， 把树皮剥尽，丢在一旁， 使枝条露白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使我的葡萄树荒凉， 折断了我的无花果树， 把树皮剥尽，丢在一旁， 使枝条露白。
verses.textZhCuv: 它毁坏我的葡萄树， 剥了我无花果树的皮， 剥尽而丢弃，使枝条露白。
verses.textEnNiv: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.
verses.textEnEsv: It has laid waste my vine and splintered my fig tree; it has stripped off their bark and thrown it down; their branches are made white.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has laid waste My vine, And ruined My fig tree; He has stripped it bare and thrown it away; Its branches are made white.
verses.textEnNlt: It has destroyed my grapevines and ruined my fig trees, stripping their bark and destroying it, leaving the branches white and bare.
verses.textEnNasb: It has made my vine a waste And my fig tree a stump. It has stripped them bare and hurled them away; Their branches have become white.
verses.textEn: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.

verses.textZh: 你们要哀号，像少女腰束麻布， 为她幼年时许配的丈夫哀号一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要哀号，像少女腰束麻布， 为她幼年时许配的丈夫哀号一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，你当哀号，像处女腰束麻布， 为幼年的丈夫哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the betrothed of her youth.
verses.textEnEsv: Lament like a virgin wearing sackcloth for the bridegroom of her youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth For the husband of her youth.
verses.textEnNlt: Weep like a bride dressed in black, mourning the death of her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: Wail like a virgin clothed with sackcloth For the groom of her youth.
verses.textEn: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the betrothed of her youth.

verses.textZh: 素祭和奠祭都从耶和华的殿里断绝了， 事奉耶和华的祭司也都悲哀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 素祭和奠祭都从耶和华的殿里断绝了， 事奉耶和华的祭司也都悲哀。
verses.textZhCuv: 素祭和奠祭从耶和华的殿中断绝； 事奉耶和华的祭司都悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the Lord . The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The grain offering and the drink offering are cut off from the house of the Lord . The priests mourn, the ministers of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The grain offering and the drink offering Have been cut off from the house of the Lord; The priests mourn, who minister to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of the Lord . So the priests are in mourning. The ministers of the Lord are weeping.
verses.textEnNasb: The grain offering and the drink offering have been cut off From the house of the Lord. The priests mourn, The ministers of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the Lord . The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 田野荒废， 土地凄凉， 因为五谷毁坏， 新酒干竭， 油也缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野荒废， 土地凄凉， 因为五谷毁坏， 新酒干竭， 油也缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 田荒凉，地悲哀； 因为五谷毁坏， 新酒干竭，油也缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the olive oil fails.
verses.textEnEsv: The fields are destroyed, the ground mourns, because the grain is destroyed, the wine dries up, the oil languishes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The field is wasted, The land mourns; For the grain is ruined, The new wine is dried up, The oil fails.
verses.textEnNlt: The fields are ruined, the land is stripped bare. The grain is destroyed, the grapes have shriveled, and the olive oil is gone.
verses.textEnNasb: The field is ruined, The land mourns; For the grain is ruined, The new wine has dried up, Fresh oil has failed.
verses.textEn: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the olive oil fails.

verses.textZh: 农夫啊！你们要为大麦和小麦羞愧。 修理葡萄园的啊！你们要哀号， 因为田间的庄稼都破坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 农夫啊！你们要为大麦和小麦羞愧。 修理葡萄园的啊！你们要哀号， 因为田间的庄稼都破坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 农夫啊，你们要惭愧； 修理葡萄园的啊，你们要哀号； 因为大麦小麦与田间的庄稼都灭绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Be ashamed, O tillers of the soil; wail, O vinedressers, for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be ashamed, you farmers, Wail, you vinedressers, For the wheat and the barley; Because the harvest of the field has perished.
verses.textEnNlt: Despair, all you farmers! Wail, all you vine growers! Weep, because the wheat and barley— all the crops of the field—are ruined.
verses.textEnNasb: Be ashamed, you farm workers, Wail, you vinedressers, For the wheat and the barley; Because the harvest of the field is destroyed.
verses.textEn: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

verses.textZh: 葡萄树枯干， 无花果树衰残； 石榴树、棕树、苹果树， 田野所有的树木都枯干， 因此欢乐从人间消失了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 葡萄树枯干， 无花果树衰残； 石榴树、棕树、苹果树， 田野所有的树木都枯干， 因此欢乐从人间消失了。
verses.textZhCuv: 葡萄树枯干； 无花果树衰残。 石榴树、棕树、苹果树， 连田野一切的树木也都枯干； 众人的喜乐尽都消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree— all the trees of the field—are dried up. Surely the people’s joy is withered away.
verses.textEnEsv: The vine dries up; the fig tree languishes. Pomegranate, palm, and apple, all the trees of the field are dried up, and gladness dries up from the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: The vine has dried up, And the fig tree has withered; The pomegranate tree, The palm tree also, And the apple tree— All the trees of the field are withered; Surely joy has withered away from the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: The grapevines have dried up, and the fig trees have withered. The pomegranate trees, palm trees, and apple trees— all the fruit trees—have dried up. And the people’s joy has dried up with them.
verses.textEnNasb: The vine has dried up And the fig tree has withered; The pomegranate, the palm also, and the apple tree, All the trees of the field have dried up. Indeed, joy has dried up From the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree— all the trees of the field—are dried up. Surely the people’s joy is withered away.

verses.textZh: 祭司啊！你们要腰束麻布，并且痛哭。 在祭坛侍候的啊！你们要哀号。 事奉我的神的啊！你们披上麻布进去过夜吧， 因为素祭和奠祭， 都从你们的神的殿中止息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司啊！你们要腰束麻布，并且痛哭。 在祭坛侍候的啊！你们要哀号。 事奉我的神的啊！你们披上麻布进去过夜吧， 因为素祭和奠祭， 都从你们的神的殿中止息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司啊，你们当腰束麻布痛哭； 伺候祭坛的啊，你们要哀号； 事奉我神的啊，你们要来披上麻布过夜， 因为素祭和奠祭从你们神的殿中断绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Put on sackcloth, you priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Go in, pass the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God! Because grain offering and drink offering are withheld from the house of your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gird yourselves and lament, you priests; Wail, you who minister before the altar; Come, lie all night in sackcloth, You who minister to my God; For the grain offering and the drink offering Are withheld from the house of your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Dress yourselves in burlap and weep, you priests! Wail, you who serve before the altar! Come, spend the night in burlap, you ministers of my God. For there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of your God.
verses.textEnNasb: Put on sackcloth And mourn, you priests; Wail, you ministers of the altar! Come, spend the night in sackcloth, You ministers of my God, For the grain offering and the drink offering Have been withheld from the house of your God.
verses.textEn: Put on sackcloth, you priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.

verses.textZh: 你们要把禁食的日子分别为圣， 召开严肃会， 聚集众长老 和国中所有的居民， 到你们的神耶和华的殿里， 向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把禁食的日子分别为圣， 召开严肃会， 聚集众长老 和国中所有的居民， 到你们的神耶和华的殿里， 向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要分定禁食的日子， 宣告严肃会， 招聚长老和国中的一切居民 到耶和华－你们神的殿， 向耶和华哀求。
verses.textEnNiv: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the Lord your God, and cry out to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Consecrate a fast; call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the Lord your God, and cry out to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Consecrate a fast, Call a sacred assembly; Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land Into the house of the Lord your God, And cry out to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting. Bring the leaders and all the people of the land into the Temple of the Lord your God, and cry out to him there.
verses.textEnNasb: Consecrate a fast, Proclaim a solemn assembly; Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land To the house of the Lord your God, And cry out to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the Lord your God, and cry out to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 哀哉那日！ 因为耶和华的日子临近了； 那日来到，好象毁灭从全能者临到一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哀哉那日！ 因为耶和华的日子临近了； 那日来到，好象毁灭从全能者临到一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哉！耶和华的日子临近了。 这日来到，好像毁灭从全能者来到。
verses.textEnNiv: Alas for that day! For the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Alas for the day! For the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from the Almighty it comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Alas for the day! For the day of the Lordis at hand; It shall come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: The day of the Lord is near, the day when destruction comes from the Almighty. How terrible that day will be!
verses.textEnNasb: Woe for the day! For the day of the Lord is near, And it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.textEn: Alas for that day! For the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 粮食不是在我们的眼前断绝了吗？ 欢喜与快乐不是从我们的神的殿中止息了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 粮食不是在我们的眼前断绝了吗？ 欢喜与快乐不是从我们的神的殿中止息了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 粮食不是在我们眼前断绝了吗？ 欢喜快乐不是从我们神的殿中止息了吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, Joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.textEnNlt: Our food disappears before our very eyes. No joyful celebrations are held in the house of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Has food not been cut off before our eyes, and Joy and rejoicing from the house of our God?
verses.textEn: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?

verses.textZh: 谷种在土块底下朽烂， 仓库荒凉，谷仓破烂被拆毁， 因为五谷都枯干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谷种在土块底下朽烂， 仓库荒凉，谷仓破烂被拆毁， 因为五谷都枯干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 谷种在土块下朽烂； 仓也荒凉，廪也破坏； 因为五谷枯干了。
verses.textEnNiv: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.
verses.textEnEsv: The seed shrivels under the clods; the storehouses are desolate; the granaries are torn down because the grain has dried up.
verses.textEnNkjv: The seed shrivels under the clods, Storehouses are in shambles; Barns are broken down, For the grain has withered.
verses.textEnNlt: The seeds die in the parched ground, and the grain crops fail. The barns stand empty, and granaries are abandoned.
verses.textEnNasb: The seeds have dried up under their shovels; The storehouses have become desolate, The grain silos are ruined, Because the grain has dried up.
verses.textEn: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.

verses.textZh: 牲畜发出哀鸣， 牛群到处流荡， 因为没有草场给牠们， 羊群也同样受苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牲畜发出哀鸣， 牛群到处流荡， 因为没有草场给牠们， 羊群也同样受苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 牲畜哀鸣； 牛群混乱，因为无草； 羊群也受了困苦。
verses.textEnNiv: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: How the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed because there is no pasture for them; even the flocks of sheep suffer.
verses.textEnNkjv: How the animals groan! The herds of cattle are restless, Because they have no pasture; Even the flocks of sheep suffer punishment.
verses.textEnNlt: How the animals moan with hunger! The herds of cattle wander about confused, because they have no pasture. The flocks of sheep and goats bleat in misery.
verses.textEnNasb: How the animals have groaned! The herds of cattle have wandered aimlessly Because there is no pasture for them; Even the flocks of sheep have suffered.
verses.textEn: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我向你呼求， 因为火吞灭了旷野的草场， 火焰烧尽了田间所有的树木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我向你呼求， 因为火吞灭了旷野的草场， 火焰烧尽了田间所有的树木。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我向你求告， 因为火烧灭旷野的草场； 火焰烧尽田野的树木。
verses.textEnNiv: To you, Lord , I call, for fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O Lord , I call. For fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, to You I cry out; For fire has devoured the open pastures, And a flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , help us! The fire has consumed the wilderness pastures, and flames have burned up all the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: To You, Lord, I cry out; For fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, And the flame has burned up all the trees of the field.
verses.textEn: To you, Lord , I call, for fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

verses.textZh: 田野的走兽也向你发喘， 因为溪水都干涸了， 火吞灭了旷野的草场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野的走兽也向你发喘， 因为溪水都干涸了， 火吞灭了旷野的草场。
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的走兽向你发喘； 因为溪水干涸， 火也烧灭旷野的草场。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the wild animals pant for you; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: Even the beasts of the field pant for you because the water brooks are dried up, and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beasts of the field also cry out to You, For the water brooks are dried up, And fire has devoured the open pastures.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the wild animals cry out to you because the streams have dried up, and fire has consumed the wilderness pastures.
verses.textEnNasb: Even the animals of the field pant for You; For the stream beds of water are dried up, And fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Even the wild animals pant for you; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 你们要在锡安吹号， 并在我的圣山发出警讯， 让国中所有的居民都战栗， 因为耶和华的日子快到，必然临近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在锡安吹号， 并在我的圣山发出警讯， 让国中所有的居民都战栗， 因为耶和华的日子快到，必然临近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在锡安吹角， 在我圣山吹出大声。 国中的居民都要发颤； 因为耶和华的日子将到， 已经临近。
verses.textEnNiv: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the Lord is coming. It is close at hand—
verses.textEnEsv: Blow a trumpet in Zion; sound an alarm on my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the Lord is coming; it is near,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blow the trumpet in Zion, And sound an alarm in My holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble; For the day of the Lord is coming, For it is at hand:
verses.textEnNlt: Sound the trumpet in Jerusalem ! Raise the alarm on my holy mountain! Let everyone tremble in fear because the day of the Lord is upon us.
verses.textEnNasb: Blow a trumpet in Zion, And sound an alarm on My holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, For the day of the Lord is coming; Indeed, it is near,
verses.textEn: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the Lord is coming. It is close at hand—

verses.textZh: 那日是黑暗幽冥的日子， 是密云漆黑的日子。 有一队众多强盛的民来到， 好象晨光满布群山； 这样的事从前没有发生过， 以后直到万代，也不会发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日是黑暗幽冥的日子， 是密云漆黑的日子。 有一队众多强盛的民来到， 好象晨光满布群山； 这样的事从前没有发生过， 以后直到万代，也不会发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、 密云、乌黑的日子， 好像晨光铺满山岭。 有一队蝗虫 又大又强； 从来没有这样的， 以后直到万代也必没有。
verses.textEnNiv: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains a large and mighty army comes, such as never was in ancient times nor ever will be in ages to come.
verses.textEnEsv: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness! Like blackness there is spread upon the mountains a great and powerful people; their like has never been before, nor will be again after them through the years of all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness, Like the morning clouds spread over the mountains. A people come, great and strong, The like of whom has never been; Nor will there ever be any such after them, Even for many successive generations.
verses.textEnNlt: It is a day of darkness and gloom, a day of thick clouds and deep blackness. Suddenly, like dawn spreading across the mountains, a great and mighty army appears. Nothing like it has been seen before or will ever be seen again.
verses.textEnNasb: A day of darkness and gloom, A day of clouds and thick darkness. As dawn is spread over the mountains, So there is a great and mighty people; There has never been anything like it, Nor will there be again after it To the years of many generations.
verses.textEn: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains a large and mighty army comes, such as never was in ancient times nor ever will be in ages to come.

verses.textZh: 在他们前面有吞灭的火， 在他们后面有燃烧的火焰； 他们未到以前，大地像伊甸园， 他们过去以后，大地成了荒凉的旷野， 没有一样能逃避他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们前面有吞灭的火， 在他们后面有燃烧的火焰； 他们未到以前，大地像伊甸园， 他们过去以后，大地成了荒凉的旷野， 没有一样能逃避他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们前面如火烧灭， 后面如火焰烧尽。 未到以前，地如伊甸园； 过去以后，成了荒凉的旷野； 没有一样能躲避它们的。
verses.textEnNiv: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste— nothing escapes them.
verses.textEnEsv: Fire devours before them, and behind them a flame burns. The land is like the garden of Eden before them, but behind them a desolate wilderness, and nothing escapes them.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fire devours before them, And behind them a flame burns; The land is like the Garden of Eden before them, And behind them a desolate wilderness; Surely nothing shall escape them.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire burns in front of them, and flames follow after them. Ahead of them the land lies as beautiful as the Garden of Eden. Behind them is nothing but desolation; not one thing escapes.
verses.textEnNasb: A fire consumes before them, And behind them a flame devours. The land is like the Garden of Eden before them, But a desolate wilderness behind them, And nothing at all escapes them.
verses.textEn: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste— nothing escapes them.

verses.textZh: 他们的形状像马的形状， 战马怎样奔跑，他们也怎样奔跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的形状像马的形状， 战马怎样奔跑，他们也怎样奔跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们的形状如马， 奔跑如马兵。
verses.textEnNiv: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.
verses.textEnEsv: Their appearance is like the appearance of horses, and like war horses they run.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their appearance is like the appearance of horses; And like swift steeds, so they run.
verses.textEnNlt: They look like horses; they charge forward like warhorses.
verses.textEnNasb: Their appearance is like the appearance of horses; And like war horses, so they run.
verses.textEn: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.

verses.textZh: 他们在群山顶上跳跃的声音， 如战车的响声， 又如火焰 吞灭碎秸的响声， 像强盛的民 摆阵预备作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在群山顶上跳跃的声音， 如战车的响声， 又如火焰 吞灭碎秸的响声， 像强盛的民 摆阵预备作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 在山顶蹦跳的响声如车辆的响声， 又如火焰烧碎秸的响声， 好像强盛的民摆阵预备打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: As with the rumbling of chariots, they leap on the tops of the mountains, like the crackling of a flame of fire devouring the stubble, like a powerful army drawn up for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: With a noise like chariots Over mountaintops they leap, Like the noise of a flaming fire that devours the stubble, Like a strong people set in battle array.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at them as they leap along the mountaintops. Listen to the noise they make—like the rumbling of chariots, like the roar of fire sweeping across a field of stubble, or like a mighty army moving into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: With a noise as of chariots They leap about on the tops of the mountains, Like the crackling of a flame of fire consuming the stubble, Like a mighty people drawn up for battle.
verses.textEn: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.

verses.textZh: 在他们面前，万民苦恼， 人人脸红耳赤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们面前，万民苦恼， 人人脸红耳赤。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们一来，众民伤恸， 脸都变色。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.
verses.textEnEsv: Before them peoples are in anguish; all faces grow pale.
verses.textEnNkjv: Before them the people writhe in pain; All faces are drained of color.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear grips all the people; every face grows pale with terror.
verses.textEnNasb: Before them the people are in anguish; All faces turn pale.
verses.textEn: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.

verses.textZh: 他们奔跑像勇士， 又像战士爬上城墙； 他们各按自己的路前行， 并不偏离路线。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们奔跑像勇士， 又像战士爬上城墙； 他们各按自己的路前行， 并不偏离路线。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们如勇士奔跑， 像战士爬城； 各都步行，不乱队伍。
verses.textEnNiv: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.
verses.textEnEsv: Like warriors they charge; like soldiers they scale the wall. They march each on his way; they do not swerve from their paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: They run like mighty men, They climb the wall like men of war; Every one marches in formation, And they do not break ranks.
verses.textEnNlt: The attackers march like warriors and scale city walls like soldiers. Straight forward they march, never breaking rank.
verses.textEnNasb: They run like warriors, They climb the wall like soldiers; And each of them marches in line, Nor do they lose their way.
verses.textEn: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此不拥挤， 各按自己的道前行； 甚至他们持着兵器跌倒， 也不会被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此不拥挤， 各按自己的道前行； 甚至他们持着兵器跌倒， 也不会被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼此并不拥挤，向前各行其路， 直闯兵器，不偏左右。
verses.textEnNiv: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.
verses.textEnEsv: They do not jostle one another; each marches in his path; they burst through the weapons and are not halted.
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not push one another; Every one marches in his own column. Though they lunge between the weapons, They are not cut down.
verses.textEnNlt: They never jostle each other; each moves in exactly the right position. They break through defenses without missing a step.
verses.textEnNasb: They do not crowd each other, Every warrior of them marches in his path; When they burst through the defenses, They do not break ranks.
verses.textEn: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.

verses.textZh: 他们冲入城镇， 奔上城墙， 爬进房屋， 像盗贼一样从窗户爬进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们冲入城镇， 奔上城墙， 爬进房屋， 像盗贼一样从窗户爬进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们蹦上城，蹿上墙， 爬上房屋， 进入窗户如同盗贼。
verses.textEnNiv: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.
verses.textEnEsv: They leap upon the city, they run upon the walls, they climb up into the houses, they enter through the windows like a thief.
verses.textEnNkjv: They run to and fro in the city, They run on the wall; They climb into the houses, They enter at the windows like a thief.
verses.textEnNlt: They swarm over the city and run along its walls. They enter all the houses, climbing like thieves through the windows.
verses.textEnNasb: They storm the city, They run on the wall; They climb into the houses, They enter through the windows like a thief.
verses.textEn: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.

verses.textZh: 在他们面前，大地震动， 诸天摇撼， 日月昏暗， 星星无光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们面前，大地震动， 诸天摇撼， 日月昏暗， 星星无光。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们一来， 地震天动， 日月昏暗， 星宿无光。
verses.textEnNiv: Before them the earth shakes, the heavens tremble, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth quakes before them; the heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth quakes before them, The heavens tremble; The sun and moon grow dark, And the stars diminish their brightness.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth quakes as they advance, and the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.
verses.textEnNasb: Before them the earth quakes, The heavens tremble, The sun and the moon become dark, And the stars lose their brightness.
verses.textEn: Before them the earth shakes, the heavens tremble, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在他的军队前头 发出声音； 他的队伍极大， 成就他话语的，是强盛的人。 耶和华的日子伟大， 非常可畏，谁能忍受得住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在他的军队前头 发出声音； 他的队伍极大， 成就他话语的，是强盛的人。 耶和华的日子伟大， 非常可畏，谁能忍受得住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在他军旅前发声， 他的队伍甚大； 成就他命的是强盛者。 因为耶和华的日子大而可畏， 谁能当得起呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty is the army that obeys his command. The day of the Lord is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord utters his voice before his army, for his camp is exceedingly great; he who executes his word is powerful. For the day of the Lord is great and very awesome; who can endure it?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord gives voice before His army, For His camp is very great; For strong istheOne who executes His word. For the day of the Lordis great and very terrible; Who can endure it?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is at the head of the column. He leads them with a shout. This is his mighty army, and they follow his orders. The day of the Lord is an awesome, terrible thing. Who can possibly survive?
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord utters His voice before His army; His camp is indeed very great, For mighty is one who carries out His word. The day of the Lord is indeed great and very awesome, And who can endure it?
verses.textEn: The Lord thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty is the army that obeys his command. The day of the Lord is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "现在虽然如此， 你们仍要全心全意， 以禁食、哭泣、哀号，归向我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "现在虽然如此， 你们仍要全心全意， 以禁食、哭泣、哀号，归向我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：虽然如此， 你们应当禁食、哭泣、悲哀， 一心归向我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Even now," declares the Lord , "return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning."
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet even now," declares the Lord , "return to me with all your heart, with fasting, with weeping, and with mourning;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now, therefore," says the Lord, "Turn to Me with all your heart, With fasting, with weeping, and with mourning."
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord says, "Turn to me now, while there is time. Give me your hearts. Come with fasting, weeping, and mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet even now," declares the Lord, "Return to Me with all your heart, And with fasting, weeping, and mourning;
verses.textEn: "Even now," declares the Lord , "return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning."

verses.textZh: 你们要撕裂你们的心肠， 不要撕裂你们的衣服。 并要归向耶和华你们的神， 因为他有恩典有怜悯， 不轻易发怒， 并且有丰盛的慈爱， 随时转意不降灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要撕裂你们的心肠， 不要撕裂你们的衣服。 并要归向耶和华你们的神， 因为他有恩典有怜悯， 不轻易发怒， 并且有丰盛的慈爱， 随时转意不降灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要撕裂心肠， 不撕裂衣服。 归向耶和华－你们的神； 因为他有恩典，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒， 有丰盛的慈爱， 并且后悔不降所说的灾。
verses.textEnNiv: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.
verses.textEnEsv: and rend your hearts and not your garments." Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love; and he relents over disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: So rend your heart, and not your garments; Return to the Lord your God, For He is gracious and merciful, Slow to anger, and of great kindness; And He relents from doing harm.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t tear your clothing in your grief, but tear your hearts instead." Return to the Lord your God, for he is merciful and compassionate, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love. He is eager to relent and not punish.
verses.textEnNasb: And tear your heart and not merely your garments." Now return to the Lord your God, For He is gracious and compassionate, Slow to anger, abounding in mercy And relenting of catastrophe.
verses.textEn: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.

verses.textZh: 有谁知道或许他会转意，并且施慈爱， 留下余福， 就是留下献给耶和华你们的神的素祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有谁知道或许他会转意，并且施慈爱， 留下余福， 就是留下献给耶和华你们的神的素祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者他转意后悔，留下余福， 就是留下献给耶和华－你们神的素祭和奠祭， 也未可知。
verses.textEnNiv: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave behind a blessing— grain offerings and drink offerings for the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Who knows whether he will not turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, a grain offering and a drink offering for the Lord your God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who knows if He will turn and relent, And leave a blessing behind Him— A grain offering and a drink offering For the Lord your God?
verses.textEnNlt: Who knows? Perhaps he will give you a reprieve, sending you a blessing instead of this curse. Perhaps you will be able to offer grain and wine to the Lord your God as before.
verses.textEnNasb: Who knows, He might turn and relent, And leave a blessing behind Him, Resulting in a grain offering and a drink offering For the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave behind a blessing— grain offerings and drink offerings for the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: 你们要在锡安吹号角， 把禁食的日子分别为圣， 召开严肃会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在锡安吹号角， 把禁食的日子分别为圣， 召开严肃会。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在锡安吹角， 分定禁食的日子， 宣告严肃会。
verses.textEnNiv: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: Blow the trumpet in Zion; consecrate a fast; call a solemn assembly;
verses.textEnNkjv: Blow the trumpet in Zion, Consecrate a fast, Call a sacred assembly;
verses.textEnNlt: Blow the ram’s horn in Jerusalem! Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting.
verses.textEnNasb: Blow a trumpet in Zion, Consecrate a fast, proclaim a solemn assembly,
verses.textEn: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

verses.textZh: 你们要召集民众， 使会众分别为圣； 招聚老人， 聚集孩童， 和在怀中吃奶的婴孩； 让新郎从新房出来， 新妇从内室出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要召集民众， 使会众分别为圣； 招聚老人， 聚集孩童， 和在怀中吃奶的婴孩； 让新郎从新房出来， 新妇从内室出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 聚集众民，使会众自洁： 招聚老者， 聚集孩童和吃奶的； 使新郎出离洞房， 新妇出离内室。
verses.textEnNiv: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.
verses.textEnEsv: gather the people. Consecrate the congregation; assemble the elders; gather the children, even nursing infants. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather the people, Sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children and nursing babes; Let the bridegroom go out from his chamber, And the bride from her dressing room.
verses.textEnNlt: Gather all the people— the elders, the children, and even the babies. Call the bridegroom from his quarters and the bride from her private room.
verses.textEnNasb: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children and the nursing infants. Have the groom come out of his room And the bride out of her bridal chamber.
verses.textEn: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.

verses.textZh: 让事奉耶和华的祭司 在圣殿的廊子和祭坛之间哭泣， 让他们说："耶和华啊！求你怜恤你的子民。 不要使你的产业受羞辱， 使他们在列国中成为笑谈。 为甚么容人在万民中讥笑说： ‘他们的神在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 让事奉耶和华的祭司 在圣殿的廊子和祭坛之间哭泣， 让他们说："耶和华啊！求你怜恤你的子民。 不要使你的产业受羞辱， 使他们在列国中成为笑谈。 为甚么容人在万民中讥笑说： ‘他们的神在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 事奉耶和华的祭司 要在廊子和祭坛中间哭泣，说： 耶和华啊，求你顾惜你的百姓， 不要使你的产业受羞辱， 列邦管辖他们。 为何容列国的人说： 「他们的神在哪里」呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Let the priests, who minister before the Lord , weep between the portico and the altar. Let them say, "Spare your people, Lord . Do not make your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Between the vestibule and the altar let the priests, the ministers of the Lord , weep and say, "Spare your people, O Lord , and make not your heritage a reproach, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the priests, who minister to the Lord, Weep between the porch and the altar; Let them say, "Spare Your people, O Lord, And do not give Your heritage to reproach, That the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Let the priests, who minister in the Lord ’s presence, stand and weep between the entry room to the Temple and the altar. Let them pray, "Spare your people, Lord ! Don’t let your special possession become an object of mockery. Don’t let them become a joke for unbelieving foreigners who say, ‘Has the God of Israel left them?’"
verses.textEnNasb: Let the priests, the Lord’s ministers, Weep between the porch and the altar, And let them say, " Spare Your people, Lord, And do not make Your inheritance a disgrace, With the nations jeering at them. Why should those among the peoples say, ‘Where is their God?’ "
verses.textEn: Let the priests, who minister before the Lord , weep between the portico and the altar. Let them say, "Spare your people, Lord . Do not make your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ "

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华为了自己的地发热心， 怜恤他的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华为了自己的地发热心， 怜恤他的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就为自己的地发热心， 怜恤他的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord was jealous for his land and took pity on his people.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord became jealous for his land and had pity on his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord will be zealous for His land, And pity His people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will pity his people and jealously guard the honor of his land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord will be zealous for His land, And will have compassion for His people.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord was jealous for his land and took pity on his people.

verses.textZh: 耶和华应允他的子民，对他们说： "看哪！我必赐给你们 五谷、新酒和新油， 你们必吃得饱足， 我必不再使你们 成为列国中的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华应允他的子民，对他们说： "看哪！我必赐给你们 五谷、新酒和新油， 你们必吃得饱足， 我必不再使你们 成为列国中的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华应允他的百姓说： 我必赐给你们五谷、新酒，和油， 使你们饱足； 我也不再使你们受列国的羞辱；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied to them: "I am sending you grain, new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy you fully; never again will I make you an object of scorn to the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord answered and said to his people, "Behold, I am sending to you grain, wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will answer and say to His people, "Behold, I will send you grain and new wine and oil, And you will be satisfied by them; I will no longer make you a reproach among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will reply, "Look! I am sending you grain and new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy your needs. You will no longer be an object of mockery among the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will answer and say to His people, "Behold, I am going to send you grain, new wine, and oil, And you will be satisfied in full with them; And I will never again make you a disgrace among the nations.
verses.textEn: The Lord replied to them: "I am sending you grain, new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy you fully; never again will I make you an object of scorn to the nations.

verses.textZh: 我要使北方来的军队 远离你们； 我要把他们驱逐 到干旱荒凉之地， 他们的前队赶入东海， 他们的后队赶入西海； 并且他们的臭气上升， 他们的腥味上腾， 因为耶和华行了大事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使北方来的军队 远离你们； 我要把他们驱逐 到干旱荒凉之地， 他们的前队赶入东海， 他们的后队赶入西海； 并且他们的臭气上升， 他们的腥味上腾， 因为耶和华行了大事。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要使北方来的军队远离你们， 将他们赶到干旱荒废之地： 前队赶入东海， 后队赶入西海； 因为他们所行的大恶 ， 臭气上升，腥味腾空。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will drive the northern horde far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land; its eastern ranks will drown in the Dead Sea and its western ranks in the Mediterranean Sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise." Surely he has done great things!
verses.textEnEsv: "I will remove the northerner far from you, and drive him into a parched and desolate land, his vanguard into the eastern sea, and his rear guard into the western sea; the stench and foul smell of him will rise, for he has done great things.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I will remove far from you the northern army, And will drive him away into a barren and desolate land, With his face toward the eastern sea And his back toward the western sea; His stench will come up, And his foul odor will rise, Because he has done monstrous things."
verses.textEnNlt: I will drive away these armies from the north. I will send them into the parched wastelands. Those in the front will be driven into the Dead Sea, and those at the rear into the Mediterranean. The stench of their rotting bodies will rise over the land." Surely the Lord has done great things!
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will remove the northern army far from you, And I will drive it into a dry and desolate land, Its advance guard into the eastern sea, And its rear guard into the western sea. And its stench will ascend and its odor of decay will come up, Because it has done great things."
verses.textEn: "I will drive the northern horde far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land; its eastern ranks will drown in the Dead Sea and its western ranks in the Mediterranean Sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise." Surely he has done great things!

verses.textZh: 地土啊！你不要惧怕； 你要欢喜快乐， 因为耶和华行了大事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地土啊！你不要惧怕； 你要欢喜快乐， 因为耶和华行了大事。
verses.textZhCuv: 地土啊，不要惧怕； 要欢喜快乐， 因为耶和华行了大事。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid, land of Judah; be glad and rejoice. Surely the Lord has done great things!
verses.textEnEsv: "Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice, for the Lord has done great things!
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear not, O land; Be glad and rejoice, For the Lord has done marvelous things!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be afraid, O land. Be glad now and rejoice, for the Lord has done great things.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not fear, land; shout for joy and rejoice, For the Lord has done great things.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid, land of Judah; be glad and rejoice. Surely the Lord has done great things!

verses.textZh: 田野的走兽啊，你们不要惧怕， 因为旷野的草场又发青了， 树木又结果子了， 无花果树和葡萄树也都效力了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野的走兽啊，你们不要惧怕， 因为旷野的草场又发青了， 树木又结果子了， 无花果树和葡萄树也都效力了。
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的走兽啊，不要惧怕； 因为，旷野的草发生， 树木结果， 无花果树、葡萄树也都效力。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid, you wild animals, for the pastures in the wilderness are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.
verses.textEnEsv: Fear not, you beasts of the field, for the pastures of the wilderness are green; the tree bears its fruit; the fig tree and vine give their full yield.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be afraid, you beasts of the field; For the open pastures are springing up, And the tree bears its fruit; The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field, for the wilderness pastures will soon be green. The trees will again be filled with fruit; fig trees and grapevines will be loaded down once more.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not fear, animals of the field, For the pastures of the wilderness have turned green, For the tree has produced its fruit, The fig tree and the vine have yielded in full.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid, you wild animals, for the pastures in the wilderness are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.

verses.textZh: 锡安的人民哪！你们要欢喜， 要靠耶和华你们的神快乐， 因为他赐给了你们合时的秋雨。 他给你们降下时雨， 就是秋雨春雨，像以前一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的人民哪！你们要欢喜， 要靠耶和华你们的神快乐， 因为他赐给了你们合时的秋雨。 他给你们降下时雨， 就是秋雨春雨，像以前一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民哪，你们要快乐， 为耶和华－你们的神欢喜； 因他赐给你们合宜的秋雨， 为你们降下甘霖， 就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Be glad, people of Zion, rejoice in the Lord your God, for he has given you the autumn rains because he is faithful. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
verses.textEnEsv: "Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God, for he has given the early rain for your vindication; he has poured down for you abundant rain, the early and the latter rain, as before.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be glad then, you children of Zion, And rejoice in the Lord your God; For He has given you the former rain faithfully, And He will cause the rain to come down for you— The former rain, And the latter rain in the first month.
verses.textEnNlt: Rejoice, you people of Jerusalem! Rejoice in the Lord your God! For the rain he sends demonstrates his faithfulness. Once more the autumn rains will come, as well as the rains of spring.
verses.textEnNasb: So shout for joy, you sons of Zion, And rejoice in the Lord your God; For He has given you the early rain for your vindication. And He has brought down for you the rain, The early and latter rain as before.
verses.textEn: Be glad, people of Zion, rejoice in the Lord your God, for he has given you the autumn rains because he is faithful. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.

verses.textZh: 禾场上必满了五谷； 榨酒池与油醡必溢出新酒与新油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 禾场上必满了五谷； 榨酒池与油醡必溢出新酒与新油。
verses.textZhCuv: 禾场必满了麦子； 酒榨与油榨必有新酒和油盈溢。
verses.textEnNiv: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
verses.textEnEsv: "The threshing floors shall be full of grain; the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: The threshing floors shall be full of wheat, And the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil.
verses.textEnNlt: The threshing floors will again be piled high with grain, and the presses will overflow with new wine and olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: The threshing floors will be full of grain, And the vats will overflow with the new wine and oil.
verses.textEn: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

verses.textZh: 我差遣到你们中间去的， 我的大军队， 就是蝗虫、蝻子、蚂蚱和剪虫， 在那些年间吃尽的， 我必补给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我差遣到你们中间去的， 我的大军队， 就是蝗虫、蝻子、蚂蚱和剪虫， 在那些年间吃尽的， 我必补给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我打发到你们中间的大军队， 就是蝗虫、蝻子、蚂蚱、剪虫， 那些年所吃的，我要补还你们。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten— the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm — my great army that I sent among you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the hopper, the destroyer, and the cutter, my great army, which I sent among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, The crawling locust, The consuming locust, And the chewing locust, My great army which I sent among you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "I will give you back what you lost to the swarming locusts, the hopping locusts, the stripping locusts, and the cutting locusts. It was I who sent this great destroying army against you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will compensate you for the years That the swarming locust has eaten, The creeping locust, the stripping locust, and the gnawing locust— My great army which I sent among you.
verses.textEn: "I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten— the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm — my great army that I sent among you.

verses.textZh: 你们必吃得丰富， 并且饱足， 你们就赞美耶和华你们的神的名， 因为他为你们行了奇妙的事。 我的子民必永远不会羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必吃得丰富， 并且饱足， 你们就赞美耶和华你们的神的名， 因为他为你们行了奇妙的事。 我的子民必永远不会羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必多吃而得饱足， 就赞美为你们行奇妙事之耶和华－你们神的名。 我的百姓必永远不至羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the Lord your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, who has dealt wondrously with you. And my people shall never again be put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, And praise the name of the Lord your God, Who has dealt wondrously with you; And My people shall never be put to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again you will have all the food you want, and you will praise the Lord your God, who does these miracles for you. Never again will my people be disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, And you will praise the name of the Lord your God, Who has dealt wondrously with you; Then My people will never be put to shame.
verses.textEn: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the Lord your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们必知道我是在以色列中间， 又知道我是耶和华你们的神，除了我再没有别的神。 我的子民必永远不会羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们必知道我是在以色列中间， 又知道我是耶和华你们的神，除了我再没有别的神。 我的子民必永远不会羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必知道我是在以色列中间， 又知道我是耶和华－你们的神； 在我以外并无别神。 我的百姓必永远不致羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the Lord your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God and there is none else. And my people shall never again be put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am in the midst of Israel: I am the Lord your God And there is no other. My people shall never be put to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will know that I am among my people Israel, that I am the Lord your God, and there is no other. Never again will my people be disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: "So you will know that I am in the midst of Israel, And that I am the Lord your God And there is no other; And My people will never be put to shame.
verses.textEn: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the Lord your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.

verses.textZh: "以后，我要把我的灵 浇灌所有的人。 你们的儿女要说预言， 你们的老年人要作异梦， 你们的少年人要见异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以后，我要把我的灵 浇灌所有的人。 你们的儿女要说预言， 你们的老年人要作异梦， 你们的少年人要见异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的老年人要做异梦， 少年人要见异象。
verses.textEnNiv: "And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
verses.textEnEsv: "And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see visions.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall come to pass afterward That I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, after doing all those things, I will pour out my Spirit upon all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.
verses.textEnNasb: " It will come about after this That I will pour out My Spirit on all mankind; And your sons and your daughters will prophesy, Your old men will have dreams, Your young men will see visions.
verses.textEn: "And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，我也要把我的灵浇灌仆人和婢女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，我也要把我的灵浇灌仆人和婢女。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女。
verses.textEnNiv: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.
verses.textEnEsv: Even on the male and female servants in those days I will pour out my Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And also on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on servants—men and women alike.
verses.textEnNasb: "And even on the male and female servants I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
verses.textEn: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.

verses.textZh: 我要在天上地下显出神迹奇事， 有血、有火、有烟柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在天上地下显出神迹奇事， 有血、有火、有烟柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在天上地下，我要显出奇事，有血，有火，有烟柱。
verses.textEnNiv: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: Blood and fire and pillars of smoke.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will cause wonders in the heavens and on the earth— blood and fire and columns of smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will display wonders in the sky and on the earth, Blood, fire, and columns of smoke.
verses.textEn: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

verses.textZh: 太阳将变为黑暗， 月亮将变为血红。 在耶和华伟大可畏的日子临到以前， 这一切都要发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳将变为黑暗， 月亮将变为血红。 在耶和华伟大可畏的日子临到以前， 这一切都要发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在耶和华大而可畏的日子未到以前。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The sun shall be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the coming of the great and awesome day of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn blood red before that great and terrible day of the Lord arrives.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sun will be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the great and awesome day of the Lord comes.
verses.textEn: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那时，求告耶和华的名的， 都必得救； 因为正如耶和华所说的， 在锡安山和耶路撒冷必有得救的人，在劫后余生的人中，必有耶和华所呼召的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，求告耶和华的名的， 都必得救； 因为正如耶和华所说的， 在锡安山和耶路撒冷必有得救的人，在劫后余生的人中，必有耶和华所呼召的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到那时候，凡求告耶和华名的就必得救；因为照耶和华所说的，在锡安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和华所召的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the Lord has said, even among the survivors whom the Lord calls.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall come to pass that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved. For in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those who escape, as the Lord has said, and among the survivors shall be those whom the Lord calls.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass That whoever calls on the name of the Lord Shall be saved. For in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be deliverance, As the Lord has said, Among the remnant whom the Lord calls.
verses.textEnNlt: But everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved, for some on Mount Zion in Jerusalem will escape, just as the Lord has said. These will be among the survivors whom the Lord has called.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord Will be saved; For on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem There will be those who escape, Just as the Lord has said, Even among the survivors whom the Lord calls.
verses.textEn: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the Lord has said, even among the survivors whom the Lord calls.

verses.textZh: "看哪！到了那些日子，在那个时期， 我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳的人归回，
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！到了那些日子，在那个时期， 我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳的人归回，
verses.textZhCuv: 「到那日，我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳之人归回的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: "In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: "For behold, in those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For behold, in those days and at that time, When I bring back the captives of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: "At the time of those events," says the Lord , "when I restore the prosperity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: " For behold, in those days and at that time, When I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: "In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 我必招聚列国， 领他们下到约沙法谷， 为了我的子民，就是我的产业以色列， 我要在那里亲临审判他们， 因为他们把我的子民分散在列国中， 又分取了我的地土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必招聚列国， 领他们下到约沙法谷， 为了我的子民，就是我的产业以色列， 我要在那里亲临审判他们， 因为他们把我的子民分散在列国中， 又分取了我的地土。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要聚集万民，带他们下到约沙法谷，在那里施行审判；因为他们将我的百姓，就是我的产业以色列，分散在列国中，又分取我的地土，
verses.textEnNiv: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to my inheritance, my people Israel, because they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.
verses.textEnEsv: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. And I will enter into judgment with them there, on behalf of my people and my heritage Israel, because they have scattered them among the nations and have divided up my land,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also gather all nations, And bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there On account of My people, My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; They have also divided up My land.
verses.textEnNlt: I will gather the armies of the world into the valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will judge them for harming my people, my special possession, for scattering my people among the nations, and for dividing up my land.
verses.textEnNasb: I will gather all the nations And bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. Then I will enter into judgment with them there On behalf of My people and My inheritance, Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; And they have divided up My land.
verses.textEn: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to my inheritance, my people Israel, because they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.

verses.textZh: 他们为我的子民抽签， 用男童交换妓女， 女童被卖换酒喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为我的子民抽签， 用男童交换妓女， 女童被卖换酒喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 且为我的百姓拈阄，将童子换妓女，卖童女买酒喝。
verses.textEnNiv: They cast lots for my people and traded boys for prostitutes; they sold girls for wine to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: and have cast lots for my people, and have traded a boy for a prostitute, and have sold a girl for wine and have drunk it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have cast lots for My people, Have given a boy aspayment for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
verses.textEnNlt: They threw dice to decide which of my people would be their slaves. They traded boys to obtain prostitutes and sold girls for enough wine to get drunk.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have also cast lots for My people, Traded a boy for a prostitute, And sold a girl for wine so that they may drink.
verses.textEn: They cast lots for my people and traded boys for prostitutes; they sold girls for wine to drink.

verses.textZh: "推罗、西顿和非利士四境的人哪！你们想对我作甚么呢？你们想向我报复吗？你们若向我报复，我很快就使报应归在你们的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "推罗、西顿和非利士四境的人哪！你们想对我作甚么呢？你们想向我报复吗？你们若向我报复，我很快就使报应归在你们的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「泰尔、西顿，和非利士四境的人哪，你们与我何干？你们要报复我吗？若报复我，我必使报应速速归到你们的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now what have you against me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying me for something I have done? If you are paying me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.
verses.textEnEsv: "What are you to me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you paying me back for something? If you are paying me back, I will return your payment on your own head swiftly and speedily.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Indeed, what have you to do with Me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? Will you retaliate against Me? But if you retaliate against Me, Swiftly and speedily I will return your retaliation upon your own head;
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you have against me, Tyre and Sidon and you cities of Philistia? Are you trying to take revenge on me? If you are, then watch out! I will strike swiftly and pay you back for everything you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, what are you to Me, Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you repaying Me with retribution? But if you are showing Me retribution, swiftly and speedily I will return your retribution on your head!
verses.textEn: "Now what have you against me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying me for something I have done? If you are paying me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.

verses.textZh: 你们拿去了我的金银，又把我的珍宝带进了你们的庙宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们拿去了我的金银，又把我的珍宝带进了你们的庙宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既然夺取我的金银，又将我可爱的宝物带入你们宫殿 ，
verses.textEnNiv: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my rich treasures into your temples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have taken My silver and My gold, And have carried into your temples My prized possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: You have taken my silver and gold and all my precious treasures, and have carried them off to your pagan temples.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you have taken My silver and My gold, brought My precious treasures to your temples,
verses.textEn: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.

verses.textZh: 你们把犹大人和耶路撒冷人卖给希腊人，使他们远离自己的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们把犹大人和耶路撒冷人卖给希腊人，使他们远离自己的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 并将犹大人和耶路撒冷人卖给希腊人 ，使他们远离自己的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.
verses.textEnEsv: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their own border.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the people of Judah and the people of Jerusalem You have sold to the Greeks, That you may remove them far from their borders.
verses.textEnNlt: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, so they could take them far from their homeland.
verses.textEnNasb: and sold the sons of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory,
verses.textEn: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要激动他们离开被你们卖到的地方，我也要使报应归到你们的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要激动他们离开被你们卖到的地方，我也要使报应归到你们的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必激动他们离开你们所卖到之地，又必使报应归到你们的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will stir them up from the place to which you have sold them, and I will return your payment on your own head.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will raise them Out of the place to which you have sold them, And will return your retaliation upon your own head.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I will bring them back from all the places to which you sold them, and I will pay you back for everything you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: behold, I am going to stir them up from the place where you have sold them, and return your retribution on your head.
verses.textEn: "See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.

verses.textZh: 我必把你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，犹大人必把他们卖给远方示巴国的人，因为这是耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，犹大人必把他们卖给远方示巴国的人，因为这是耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，他们必卖给远方示巴国的人。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away." The Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a nation far away, for the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will sell your sons and your daughters Into the hand of the people of Judah, And they will sell them to the Sabeans, To a people far off; For the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the people of Arabia, a nation far away. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will also sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a distant nation," for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away." The Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 你们要在列国中宣告以下这话： "你们要预备争战， 要激动勇士。 让所有的战士都近前来，让他们都上去攻击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在列国中宣告以下这话： "你们要预备争战， 要激动勇士。 让所有的战士都近前来，让他们都上去攻击。
verses.textZhCuv: 当在万民中宣告说： 要预备打仗； 激动勇士， 使一切战士上前来。
verses.textEnNiv: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.
verses.textEnEsv: Proclaim this among the nations: Consecrate for war; stir up the mighty men. Let all the men of war draw near; let them come up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Proclaim this among the nations: "Prepare for war! Wake up the mighty men, Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to the nations far and wide: "Get ready for war! Call out your best warriors. Let all your fighting men advance for the attack.
verses.textEnNasb: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for holy war; stir up the warriors! Have all the soldiers come forward, have them come up!
verses.textEn: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.

verses.textZh: 要把犁头打成刀剑， 把镰刀打成矛枪； 软弱的要说： ‘我是勇士。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把犁头打成刀剑， 把镰刀打成矛枪； 软弱的要说： ‘我是勇士。’
verses.textZhCuv: 要将犁头打成刀剑， 将镰刀打成戈矛； 软弱的要说：我有勇力。
verses.textEnNiv: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, "I am strong!"
verses.textEnEsv: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears; let the weak say, "I am a warrior."
verses.textEnNkjv: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Hammer your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Train even your weaklings to be warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: Beat your plowshares into swords, And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak man say, "I am a warrior."
verses.textEn: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, "I am strong!"

verses.textZh: 四围的列国啊！ 你们快来帮助， 在那里一同聚集。 耶和华啊！求你叫你的勇士下来吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四围的列国啊！ 你们快来帮助， 在那里一同聚集。 耶和华啊！求你叫你的勇士下来吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 四围的列国啊， 你们要速速地来， 一同聚集。 耶和华啊， 求你使你的大能者降临。
verses.textEnNiv: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: Hasten and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves there. Bring down your warriors, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Assemble and come, all you nations, And gather together all around. Cause Your mighty ones to go down there, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Come quickly, all you nations everywhere. Gather together in the valley." And now, O Lord , call out your warriors!
verses.textEnNasb: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, And gather yourselves there. Bring down, Lord, Your warriors.
verses.textEn: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, Lord !

verses.textZh: "万国都当奋起， 上到约沙法谷去。 因为我必坐在那里， 审判四围的列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万国都当奋起， 上到约沙法谷去。 因为我必坐在那里， 审判四围的列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民都当兴起， 上到约沙法谷； 因为我必坐在那里， 审判四围的列国。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the nations stir themselves up and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let the nations be wakened, and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; For there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let the nations be called to arms. Let them march to the valley of Jehoshaphat. There I, the Lord , will sit to pronounce judgment on them all.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the nations be awakened And come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, For there I will sit to judge All the surrounding nations.
verses.textEn: "Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.

verses.textZh: 你们要伸出镰刀， 因为庄稼已经熟了。 来践踏吧， 因为压酒池满了， 酒池盈溢， 因为他们的罪恶极大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要伸出镰刀， 因为庄稼已经熟了。 来践踏吧， 因为压酒池满了， 酒池盈溢， 因为他们的罪恶极大。
verses.textZhCuv: 开镰吧！因为庄稼熟了； 践踏吧！因为酒榨满了。 酒池盈溢； 他们的罪恶甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow— so great is their wickedness!"
verses.textEnEsv: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Go in, tread, for the winepress is full. The vats overflow, for their evil is great.
verses.textEnNkjv: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, go down; For the winepress is full, The vats overflow— For their wickedness is great."
verses.textEnNlt: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread the grapes, for the winepress is full. The storage vats are overflowing with the wickedness of these people."
verses.textEnNasb: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread the grapes, for the wine press is full; The vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.
verses.textEn: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow— so great is their wickedness!"

verses.textZh: 无数的人群 齐集在判决谷， 因为耶和华的日子临近了判决谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无数的人群 齐集在判决谷， 因为耶和华的日子临近了判决谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 许多许多的人在断定谷， 因为耶和华的日子临近断定谷。
verses.textEnNiv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.textEnEsv: Multitudes, multitudes, in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.textEnNkjv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lordis near in the valley of decision.
verses.textEnNlt: Thousands upon thousands are waiting in the valley of decision. There the day of the Lord will soon arrive.
verses.textEnNasb: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.textEn: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

verses.textZh: 日月昏暗， 星星无光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日月昏暗， 星星无光。
verses.textZhCuv: 日月昏暗， 星宿无光。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun and moon will grow dark, And the stars will diminish their brightness.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
verses.textEnNasb: The sun and moon have become dark, And the stars have lost their brightness.
verses.textEn: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从锡安吼叫， 并从耶路撒冷发声， 天地就震动。 耶和华却要作他子民的避难所， 作以色列众子的保障。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从锡安吼叫， 并从耶路撒冷发声， 天地就震动。 耶和华却要作他子民的避难所， 作以色列众子的保障。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声， 天地就震动。 耶和华却要作他百姓的避难所， 作以色列人的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the heavens will tremble. But the Lord will be a refuge for his people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord roars from Zion, and utters his voice from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth quake. But the Lord is a refuge to his people, a stronghold to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord also will roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem; The heavens and earth will shake; But the Lord will be a shelter for His people, And the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord ’s voice will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth will shake. But the Lord will be a refuge for his people, a strong fortress for the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord roars from Zion And utters His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth quake. But the Lord is a refuge for His people, And a stronghold for the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the heavens will tremble. But the Lord will be a refuge for his people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 你们知道我是耶和华你们的神， 是住在锡安我的圣山上。 那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣。 外族人必不得从其中经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道我是耶和华你们的神， 是住在锡安我的圣山上。 那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣。 外族人必不得从其中经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就知道我是耶和华－你们的神， 且又住在锡安－我的圣山。 那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣； 外邦人不再从其中经过。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then you will know that I, the Lord your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.
verses.textEnEsv: "So you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who dwells in Zion, my holy mountain. And Jerusalem shall be holy, and strangers shall never again pass through it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So you shall know that I am the Lord your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain. Then Jerusalem shall be holy, And no aliens shall ever pass through her again."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you will know that I, the Lord your God, live in Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy forever, and foreign armies will never conquer her again.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will know that I am the Lord your God, Dwelling on Zion, My holy mountain. So Jerusalem will be holy, And strangers will no longer pass through it.
verses.textEn: "Then you will know that I, the Lord your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.

verses.textZh: 到那日， 大山都必滴下甜酒， 小山都必流出奶， 犹大的一切溪流， 都必水流不息。 必有泉源从耶和华的殿里流出来， 灌溉什亭谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日， 大山都必滴下甜酒， 小山都必流出奶， 犹大的一切溪流， 都必水流不息。 必有泉源从耶和华的殿里流出来， 灌溉什亭谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒； 小山要流奶子； 犹大溪河都有水流。 必有泉源从耶和华的殿中流出来， 滋润什亭谷。
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the Lord ’s house and will water the valley of acacias.
verses.textEnEsv: "And in that day the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the streambeds of Judah shall flow with water; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the Lord and water the Valley of Shittim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will come to pass in that day That the mountains shall drip with new wine, The hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall be flooded with water; A fountain shall flow from the house of the Lord And water the Valley of Acacias.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. Water will fill the streambeds of Judah, and a fountain will burst forth from the Lord ’s Temple, watering the arid valley of acacias.
verses.textEnNasb: And on that day The mountains will drip with sweet wine, And the hills will flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah will flow with water; And a spring will go out from the house of the Lord And water the Valley of Shittim.
verses.textEn: "In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the Lord ’s house and will water the valley of acacias.

verses.textZh: 埃及将会荒凉， 以东必变成凄凉的旷野， 都因为他们向犹大人所行的强暴， 又因为在他们的国中流了无辜人血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及将会荒凉， 以东必变成凄凉的旷野， 都因为他们向犹大人所行的强暴， 又因为在他们的国中流了无辜人血。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及必然荒凉， 以东变为凄凉的旷野， 都因向犹大人所行的强暴， 又因在本地流无辜人的血。
verses.textEnNiv: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
verses.textEnEsv: "Egypt shall become a desolation and Edom a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the people of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom a desolate wilderness, Because of violence against the people of Judah, For they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.textEnNlt: But Egypt will become a wasteland and Edom will become a wilderness, because they attacked the people of Judah and killed innocent people in their land.
verses.textEnNasb: Egypt will become a wasteland, And Edom will become a desolate wilderness, Because of the violence done to the sons of Judah, In whose land they have shed innocent blood.
verses.textEn: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

verses.textZh: "但犹大必存到永远， 耶路撒冷也必存到万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但犹大必存到永远， 耶路撒冷也必存到万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 但犹大必存到永远； 耶路撒冷必存到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: But Judah shall be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem to all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Judah shall abide forever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Judah will be filled with people forever, and Jerusalem will endure through all generations.
verses.textEnNasb: But Judah will be inhabited forever, And Jerusalem for all generations.
verses.textEn: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.

verses.textZh: 现在我要追讨我还未有追讨的流人血的罪。 耶和华在锡安居住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我要追讨我还未有追讨的流人血的罪。 耶和华在锡安居住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我未曾报复 流血的罪， 现在我要报复， 因为耶和华住在锡安。
verses.textEnNiv: Shall I leave their innocent blood unavenged? No, I will not." The Lord dwells in Zion!
verses.textEnEsv: I will avenge their blood, blood I have not avenged, for the Lord dwells in Zion."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will acquit them of the guilt of bloodshed, whom I had not acquitted; For the Lord dwells in Zion."
verses.textEnNlt: I will pardon my people’s crimes, which I have not yet pardoned; and I, the Lord , will make my home in Jerusalem with my people."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will avenge their blood which I have not avenged, For the Lord dwells in Zion.
verses.textEn: Shall I leave their innocent blood unavenged? No, I will not." The Lord dwells in Zion!
